title: Campus Technology Desk Service and Return Standards, Student Technology Device Program
content:
The campus technology desks of the Student Technology Device Program work to the standards below for repairs, loaners, inspection on return and the deadlines for turning a device in, by loan type.

## Repair and inspection standards

| Loan type | Repair completed within | Loaner device issued while the device is in repair | Device inspected for damage when turned in |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chromebook Loan (Standard Liability) | 5 calendar days | Yes | Yes |
| Chromebook Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 5 calendar days | Yes | Yes |
| iPad Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 5 calendar days | Yes | Yes |
| Windows Laptop Loan (Standard Liability) | 5 calendar days | Yes | Yes |
| Windows Laptop Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 5 calendar days | Yes | Yes |
| Mobile Hotspot Loan | 5 calendar days | No | Yes |

## Return standards

| Loan type | Return after the last day of attendance on withdrawal (that day is day 0) | Charge for a device not returned by the deadline | Device turned in at the end of the school year | Grades that keep the device over the summer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chromebook Loan (Standard Liability) | 5 calendar days | Depreciated replacement cost | Yes | 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11 |
| Chromebook Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 5 calendar days | Depreciated replacement cost | Yes | 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11 |
| iPad Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 5 calendar days | Depreciated replacement cost | Yes | None |
| Windows Laptop Loan (Standard Liability) | 5 calendar days | Depreciated replacement cost | Yes | 09, 10, 11 |
| Windows Laptop Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 5 calendar days | Depreciated replacement cost | Yes | 09, 10, 11 |
| Mobile Hotspot Loan | 5 calendar days | Depreciated replacement cost | Yes | None |

## Reading the standards

- Every loan type carries the end-of-year turn-in; the summer-keep grade list names the grades that keep the device over the summer. Grade 12 appears on no list, and the iPad and Mobile Hotspot loan types list no grade.
- The withdrawal deadline counts calendar days after the last day of attendance, that day being day 0: a device turned in on day 5 meets the 5-day deadline; a device first turned in on day 6 does not.
- The Mobile Hotspot Loan is the one loan type with no loaner while the device is in repair.

### Hypothetical summer cases

| Hypothetical loan and grade | Turned in at year end |
|---|---|
| Chromebook loan, grade 08 | No, grade 08 keeps the device over the summer |
| Chromebook loan, grade 12 | Yes |
| Windows laptop loan, grade 10 | No, grade 10 keeps the device over the summer |
| iPad loan, grade 01 | Yes |
